claims.text: A 24 November 1947 letter from AMC intelligence to the Air Force Chief of Staff on the flying disc problem exists and is preserved in scanned form.

edges.label: McCoy ran AMC/T-2 intelligence, the exploitation node
edges.note: As Chief of Intelligence at Air Materiel Command, McCoy headed the organisation that received and exploited recovered foreign materiel and that hosted Project SIGN. Any 1947 recovery would have been processed here.

b.label: Twining Memorandum: AMC Opinion Concerning "Flying Discs"

edges.label: McCoy's shop produced the analysis Twining signed
edges.note: The AMC intelligence organisation under McCoy did the staff work behind the 23 September 1947 assessment; McCoy signed related AMC correspondence to the Chief of Staff two months later.
